This notice explains what personal data Skilient (Pvt.) Limited collects through Skilient, why we collect it, who we share it with, how long we keep it and what you can do about it.
A backup that still holds data you have deleted will be overwritten within that period, and until then it is not used for any purpose except restoring the platform after a serious failure.
Your IP address, which we use for security and rate limits and store as a hash wherever we can, your browser and device details, timestamps, error reports and request identifiers in logs.
We share Google user data only with the service providers listed in P6, which process it on our behalf and only as far as they need it to provide the features above.
A student account is for a person who is enrolled at, or has graduated from, a university listed on Skilient, and who signs up with an email address on that university's domain.
You must not share your password, let someone else use your account, sign in as someone else, create an account for another person, or use another person's email address or GitHub account.
We use GitHub activity, peer and faculty verification, credentials that people upload and short code checks as evidence, and we turn that evidence into a signed CV that recruiters can check.
When it is on, verified recruiters can find you by the skills, levels and details you choose to show, and can send you contact requests within the limits of their plan.
Universities that hold a current licence with the right feature on Skilient (at present, the Growth and Campus plans) can see an individual record for each of their own students.
Send a link to your signed CV or your Record with an application; it expires, you can revoke it, and anyone who opens it can check it at skilient.com/verify.
Reports and sanction records are kept for as long as needed to enforce a ban, decide an appeal or defend a legal claim, and are then deleted or anonymised.
Before we transfer personal data to a provider, we make sure that its contract requires it to protect the data, and we send only the data the service needs.
A shortlist entry that a recruiter made before you turned visibility off stays on their list, marked as no longer visible, and they cannot open your profile from it.
Nothing in this agreement limits liability for fraud, for death or personal injury caused by negligence, or for anything else that the law does not allow us to limit.
We use it to show your profile, skills and activity to the people and organisations that your settings and the rules allow, as described in the user agreement.
We use it to keep the platform safe, prevent fraud and enforce the rules, which is a legitimate interest and, where the law requires it, a legal obligation.
You give Skilient a non-exclusive, royalty-free, worldwide licence to host, store, copy, display, resize and otherwise process your content, and to create CV exports and previews from it.
We may hide, discount, freeze or remove evidence that looks copied, fabricated, traded or produced to game the ranking, and we may recompute your record when we do.
A recruiter sees your name and full profile only on a plan that allows it, and only after you accept a contact request or your settings allow it.
We are not responsible for employment, admission, grading, teaching or other decisions made by employers, universities, teachers or other users, or for what users say to each other.
Your university’s own space inside Skilient: branded pages, modules you switch on and off, announcements pinned for your students, and your exam periods, during which rank doesn’t decay.

thirdPerson: Skilient is a platform where university students in Pakistan prove their skills through real project work. We use GitHub activity, peer and faculty verification, credentials that people upload and short code checks as evidence, and we turn that evidence into a signed CV that recruiters can check. Universities, faculty, recruiters and our staff each have their own areas of the platform.

Other people's views are part of the evidence. Endorsements, reviews and confirmations come from people who have their own judgement and their own interests. We may hide, discount, freeze or remove evidence that looks copied, fabricated, traded or produced to game the ranking, and we may recompute your record when we do. Faculty and university staff may review or confirm work that they supervise. They must be honest, must declare any conflict of interest and must not confirm work they did not supervise.

Universities that hold a current licence with the right feature on Skilient (at present, the Growth and Campus plans) can see an individual record for each of their own students. A record shows the student's profile, skills, evidence levels and the activity on Skilient that the plan covers. Only a university's admins and the coordinator for the student's department can open a record, and every time someone opens a record it is logged. A university cannot see your chats, your recruiter activity or who has viewed your CV.

The daily profile-view limit (300) was reached by the test runs and cleared on the local DB before probes 3, 4 and 8.
